get.summary: Compute a complete revision-scoped compatible cohort before pagination
get.description: scope is bounded readable JSON. Policies explicitly select contracts, mixed configurations, collectors, definitions and populations. Membership is referenced by a signed reconstructible cohort identity. No trial evidence is fetched.

200.description: Small aggregate summary and cohort reference; full membership and report inventories are omitted

429.description: Request or cohort computation capacity exceeded

get.summary: Page exact immutable cohort membership

200.description: Bounded result/report/configuration/contract/method references and weights; cursor binds revision, normalized scope, lane and page size

get.summary: Frozen progress from published completed jobs
get.description: Frozen scope from published completed attempts. Without original locked plan content, plannedJobs and collectionComplete remain null. With verified content, plannedJobs is the machine/corpus Cartesian scope and collectionComplete means each pair has at least one published completed attempt, including failed or unsupported outcomes. publishedJobs counts attempts; publishedCorpusJobs counts distinct machine/corpus pairs. Staged imports never contribute.

get.summary: Small cards and coverage from a complete frozen cohort
get.description: Requires the same explicit bounded scope as aggregates. Omitting a revision resolves current once. Cards omit memberships and trial evidence; the signed cohort reference provides paginated membership. No default baseline or method is inferred.
